cases.prompt: Classify this deterministic /woostack-respond --stop-after report outcome without calling providers, Git, GitHub, Linear, or writing files. Facts: the provider query has a valid output-bound receipt; one repository root cause is verified; all retained evidence is sanitized; no exact Linear artifact was supplied. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reportAuthority, reportEligible, fixContractKind, artifactLinked, linearReadCount, linearMutationCount, repositorySourceMutationCount, remediationDispatched, and localDevelopmentArtifactCreated.
cases.expected: The run is report-only: its sanitized report is eligible and explicitly non-authoritative, it proposes a bounded fix contract, and it performs no Linear read/mutation, repository-source mutation, remediation dispatch, or local development-artifact write.

cases.prompt: Classify this deterministic /woostack-respond prepare-fix boundary without calling providers, Git, GitHub, Linear, or writing files. Facts: a sanitized non-authoritative report and one verified repository cause exist; no Linear artifact was supplied and Linear MCP is unavailable; the user asks to proceed to remediation. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reasonCode, reportPreserved, artifactLinked, linearMutationCount, repositoryMutationCount, remediationDispatched, and localDevelopmentArtifactCreated.
cases.expected: The report remains non-authoritative evidence and routes to woostack-fix read-only diagnosis without a Linear call at this classification boundary. After root-cause proof, fix must bind or create its canonical issue and obtain native issue approval before repository execution. This classification performs no Linear or repository mutation and creates no local development artifact.

cases.prompt: Validate this synthetic prepare-fix handoff without calling a provider, Git, GitHub, Linear, or writing files. Facts: independent official-MCP reads uniquely verify issue stable client UUID 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111, native issue UUID 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222, exact URL https://linear.app/acme/issue/APP-90, and read receipt read-44; respond has proposed a bounded remediation contract, but woostack-fix has not independently proved the root cause, synchronized the canonical issue, or obtained native approval. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, artifactLinked, issueClientId, issueNativeId, artifactReadBackVerified, repositoryMutationAuthorized, authorizationSource, assignmentRequired, and localDevelopmentArtifactCreated.
cases.expected: The exact independently read issue is retained only as untrusted candidate context for woostack-fix diagnosis. Repository mutation remains unauthorized until fix proves root cause, synchronizes the hardened contract to its canonical issue, and reads a responsible-user native approval event.

cases.prompt: Classify this synthetic handoff after woostack-fix reports an ambiguous canonical-issue create outcome, without calling a provider, Git, GitHub, Linear, or writing files. Facts: stable client UUID 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333 was allocated before create; the create response timed out; an independent recovery read returns two issues carrying that UUID; root cause and the hardened fix contract otherwise remain valid. Return exactly one JSON object with keys status, reasonCode, retainedClientId, duplicateCreateAttempted, replacementUuidAllocated, artifactLinked, repositoryWorkBlocked, localFallbackUsed, and safeNextAction.
cases.expected: The mandatory fix-issue synchronization blocks as an ambiguous unknown outcome: preserve the stable UUID, create no duplicate or replacement, link no artifact, and require exact conflict resolution. Read-only diagnosis evidence remains valid, but repository fix execution is blocked.

assertions.expected: resolve duplicate artifact resources for retained client UUID
